# NMF Molecular Subtyping

> Interactive visualisation tool for exploring Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) clustering results, molecular subtypes, marker genes, and survival analysis.

The NMF Molecular Subtyping dashboard, built by Co-Lab AccelBio, lets researchers upload NMF outputs and explore clustering quality, UMAP/PCA projections, expression heatmaps, marker genes, and multivariate Cox regression with forward/backward/stepwise selection and cross-validated concordance.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Main analysis dashboard with NMF overview, clustering metrics, UMAP, PCA, heatmap, marker genes, and survival analysis.
